faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.subtitle: Here you will find answers to the most common questions.
faq.q1: How can members be added to a residence?
faq.a1: To add members to a residence, the interested member must enter the randomly generated code by the administrator in the join residence screen.
faq.q2: How can I manage an invoice?
faq.a2: To manage an invoice, you just need to access the "My Invoices" screen in the "My Profile" section.
faq.q3: How do I remove a member from a residence?
faq.a3: The administrator can remove a member from the "My Residence" screen. The member can also leave the residence from the "My Residence" screen.
faq.q4: How can I create a residence?
faq.a4: Once registered as a user, you can create a residence by pressing the "Create Residence" option.
faq.q5: How can I manage a task?
faq.a5: From "My Profile", you can manage tasks; a dropdown will open where you can manage the date, assigned members and other parameters.

politicaCookies.title: Privacy Policy
politicaCookies.intro: At Convivia, we are committed to protecting your privacy and ensuring you have a positive experience on our platform.
politicaCookies.section1Body: We collect information you provide directly, such as your email address and profile information. We also automatically collect certain information about your device and how you interact with our services.
politicaCookies.section2Body: We use your information to provide, maintain and improve our services, communicate with you and comply with legal obligations. Your data helps us personalize your experience and improve our platform.
politicaCookies.section3Body: Cookies are small files stored on your device that help us remember your preferences and understand how you use our services. We use essential cookies for functionality, analytical cookies to improve our services, and preference cookies to remember your settings.
politicaCookies.section4Body: We implement appropriate security measures to protect your personal information from unauthorized access. However, no method of internet transmission is completely secure.
politicaCookies.section5Body: You have the right to access, update or delete your personal information. You can also control cookie preferences through your browser settings. For more information about your rights, please contact us directly.
politicaCookies.section6Body: Cookies are essential to how Convivia operates. They allow us to remember your session state, preferences, and enhance your overall experience. Different types of cookies serve different purposes on our platform.
politicaCookies.section7Body: These cookies are necessary for the website to function properly. They enable core functionality such as secure login, user authentication, and basic site navigation. You cannot disable these cookies without preventing the site from working.
politicaCookies.section8Body: We use these cookies to understand how visitors interact with our platform. They help us identify which features are most popular, track errors, and measure the overall performance of Convivia. This data is collected anonymously.
politicaCookies.section9Body: These cookies remember the choices you make to provide a personalized experience. For example, they store your language preference, theme settings, and custom layouts. Disabling them may result in reduced functionality.
politicaCookies.section10Body: Most browsers allow you to control cookies through their settings. You can choose to accept all cookies, reject non-essential cookies, or be asked each time a cookie is set. Please note that blocking cookies may impact your experience on Convivia.
politicaCookies.section11Body: Some of our service partners may place cookies on your device to analyze platform usage and provide services related to platform content and services. We are not responsible for the privacy practices of third parties.
